definitions.catalog_opportunity: full standard-start history exactly before a catalog signature; owner to move; independent of receipt
definitions.event_deduplication: one fullhistory+played-UCI is one opportunity/event; multiple catalog line labels do not multiply events; matching_catalog_rows is reported separately
definitions.authored_signature: current matching host receipt; separate from actual catalog signature board fact
definitions.signature_capture: the stationary piece on an observed signature square is actually captured before it moves; local event, not proof of net material sacrifice or soundness
definitions.capture_owner: credited to signature owner color mapped to baseline/candidate, not to the capturing actor
definitions.prefix: prefix events are tracked only to exclude them; no prefix moves enter turn/offer/activity metrics
definitions.memory_attempted: verifier attempt row, possibly geometry rejection before any native search
definitions.memory_probed: current receipt contains a completed legal finite-CP comparison line; failed raw calls are not inferred
definitions.memory_changed_move: applied and admitted memory candidate actually differs from native baseline; matching a proposal alone is not adoption
definitions.native_baseline_matches_candidate_memory: native baseline equals a memory move in the candidate arm's counterfactual current plan; can be true even when the actual baseline arm has no memory exposure
definitions.activity: one-ply geometric pseudo activity of mover, neither safe mobility nor engine strength
definitions.scope: conditional mixed development screen; separate serial/parallel and style/target; not Elo, causation or Chess.com grading
